elements.text: Trust Score and Daily News Access Frequency
Individual survey responses across OECD nations, 2021–2024
Source: news consumption habits and trust in media sour…

data.caption: Daily News Frequency against Trust Score, shown to answer relationship between daily news access frequency and reported trust score. An international media observatory and comparative research network conducted periodic population-weighted survey waves between January 2021 and December 2024 across five countries. The research tracks shifting reliance on digital channels versus traditional broadcasting, audience trust in primary information sources, and weekly engagement intensity.
